notes.title: DEMO launches at Steam Next Fest October 2024 + update on the new mechanics
notes.notes:
Hello, Commanders!
As it turns out, the Pacific is not the easiest ocean to cross. However, we are slowly pushing forward. Now we’re back with an update for you.

The game is still in production. We are constantly working on expanding the available content to deliver the best possible product to you.

In the meantime, we've added a number of new mechanics and improved the existing ones.

What can you expect?
In some missions, you will have access to tanks - a very powerful unit, though it has its limitations. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42400301/fdea5404f692df05685a9595b45391257482af57.png

From time to time, the command will be able to delegate a destroyer to assist you, providing artillery support. However, keep in mind that if misused, it can cause significant damage not only to the enemy.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42400301/86b14d2ed05b6544b815ba530e4ae9d4928c28c3.png

These are just some of the new features that will be waiting for you...

The battles will take place on various Pacific islands. Among the many missions based on historical events, there will also be room for fictional scenarios, allowing you to experience alternate versions of history.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42400301/0ac1ff0893c199470727dc2964beb237a46a761f.png

We have also prepared an additional tutorial mission to help you easily grasp all the basic game mechanics. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42400301/a75fdabdaa7ccb128d88419580c40c31e275d587.png

We also want to inform you that we are showcasing a demo of our game at the Steam Next Fest, which will take place this October. We want to give you a sample of our production to see if we’re heading in the right direction. Your feedback will help us plan our next steps.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1621910/Radio_Commander_Pacific_Campaign
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42400301/45f8ef2dd88e7600d524f56cc86dc4c8ce2d1c80.gif

We are staying on course, so keep an eye out for further announcements.
Radio Commander: Pacific Campaign team
